clients.name: Rossi Family
clients.liquidity: Maintain a three-tier liquidity reserve designed to cover at least 36 months of essential family requirements.
clients.objectives: Long-term real capital growth|Maintain family liquidity and resilience|Diversify across public and private markets
clients.priorities: Maintain the 36-month liquidity framework|Rebalance the financial portfolio annually|Develop the alternatives and succession-planning structures
clients.summary: A fictional Italian family with a €20m net worth, previous UK links and two adult children. The case allocates €10m of investable assets across €5m of public markets and €5m of alternatives, while maintaining a €1.38m three-tier liquidity reserve and coordinating direct real estate with future succession and wealth-planning structures.

taxRegimes.label: Ordinary Italian taxation
taxRegimes.summary: Worldwide recurring income is modelled under ordinary Italian rules, with UK tax on London rent and a treaty-limited foreign tax credit.

taxRegimes.label: Historical Impatriati · Years 1–5
taxRegimes.summary: Historical Sardinia treatment: 10% of qualifying Italian work income is taxable. Other Italian and foreign income remains outside the work-income relief.

taxRegimes.label: Historical Impatriati · Extension
taxRegimes.summary: 50% of qualifying work income is modelled as taxable only if the historical property-condition extension is confirmed.

taxRegimes.label: Art. 24-bis · UK included
taxRegimes.summary: Historical €100k substitute tax covers qualifying foreign income. Italian-source tax and UK source tax remain payable.

taxRegimes.label: Art. 24-bis · UK carved out
taxRegimes.summary: The UK is excluded from the substitute-tax perimeter, so UK income and assets return to ordinary Italian treatment.
